source: v8-014-backlog-map.json (r2 archive; 46 original descriptions preserved verbatim)
status_words: IMPLEMENTED (code + passing checks in the checkout) · INSTALLED_AND_DEMONSTRATED (also exercised by the module journey from the installed wheel and sdist) · HOSTED_CI_VERIFIED and RELEASED are NOT claimed for any row

rows.original_description: Connect incoming claim packets to shared evidence and claim objects; preserve exact source-root identities rather than inventing a second provenance system.
rows.code: commons._admit_packet + core.claim_ref/source_ids: packets name the workbench's own claim id, version digest, contract digest and registered source ids; unknown ids are refused or kept as unknown roots

rows.original_description: Persist duplicate groups across ingestion runs with idempotent membership updates; distinguish exact duplication from unverified semantic similarity.
rows.code: commons.group_id + journal replay: membership is an event; a repeat joins its group; op_id retries are the same event; exact identity only (no similarity is computed)

rows.original_description: Show shared primary roots and unknown ancestry; do not count many summaries of one source as independent corroboration.
rows.code: commons.dashboard shared_roots / unknown_ancestry_groups; group page lists known and unknown roots

rows.original_description: Propagate declared disputes and withdrawals through aliases and dependencies; retain the original source and reasons for quarantine.
rows.code: commons.record_dispute + _quarantine: propagation through source roots, claims, packets and declared derived_from; source bytes untouched; dashboard upstream flags for workbench withdrawals, newer versions and availability corrections

rows.original_description: Add authenticated contributor identities and admission limits; document remaining collusion and identity-abuse limits.
rows.code: authz principals + commons caps, rate and queue bounds counted per authenticated principal; guide and Modules page state the collusion/Sybil limit
rows.remaining_gap: Local credentials do not establish real-world uniqueness or prevent collusion — documented, not solved.
rows.external_evidence_or_claim_limit: Local credential authentication does not establish real-world uniqueness or prevent collusion.

rows.original_description: Replace assumed review costs with estimated and observed minutes; include triage, quarantine investigation, corrections, and coordination.
rows.code: three separate numbers: scheduling cost (authority), server-observed seconds between ACTIVE transitions, COM_EFFORT_DECLARED by category (triage, review, quarantine investigation, correction, coordination)
rows.remaining_gap: A timer and a declaration are not verified attentive human labour.
rows.external_evidence_or_claim_limit: Observed session duration and self-reported effort are not verified attentive human labor.

rows.original_description: Integrate contributor caps, review budgets, and a separately reserved practice allocation into a persistent daily or session queue.
rows.code: commons.set_budget/capacity/assign under the workspace lock; practice reserve consumed only by PRC_SESSION_OPENED; per-period

rows.original_description: Define queue rollover, cancellation, partial work, urgent review, and budget changes explicitly; log overrides rather than silently erasing backlog.
rows.code: TRANSITIONS state machine; rollover on a new period; cancel; release/partial seconds kept; COM_OVERRIDE_RECORDED; budget revisions with visible overrun

rows.original_description: Preserve useful smaller tasks when one task exceeds available capacity; display both selected work and reasons for deferral.
rows.code: commons.plan: fit-smaller, deferral reasons, aged hold, oversized escalation, unspent capacity shown

rows.original_description: Provide manual dispute resolution and appeals with reviewer identity; avoid treating an automated quarantine as a verdict of misconduct.
rows.code: record_dispute (review/admin), appeal (any signed-in principal), resolve_dispute (admin, not the recorder when appealed); wording: handling state, not misconduct

rows.original_description: Record backlog age, repeated roots, unique claims, estimated versus actual effort, and review completion without equating document volume with productivity.
rows.code: commons.dashboard: backlog age, shared roots, unique claims, estimates vs observed vs declared, completion; page wording that volume is not productivity

rows.original_description: Compare the integrated queue with a conventional queue using actual review effort, error, coverage, and contributor participation.
rows.code: commons.simulate (plain FIFO, FIFO + exact de-duplication, this rule) on identical synthetic arrivals + the dashboard counters a future voluntary comparison would use
rows.remaining_gap: ORIGINAL ROW NOT COMPLETE: no actual human effort, error, coverage or participation comparison exists; a simulation cannot supply it.
rows.external_evidence_or_claim_limit: Actual human effort/error/coverage/participation comparison requires real participants and evidence; simulation cannot complete the original row.

rows.original_description: Choose suitable, bounded financial-research tasks with a qualified reviewer; do not assume every withheld answer creates meaningful practice.
rows.code: practice.freeze_task: bounded task, declared curator qualification stored as DECLARED; public_example flag
rows.remaining_gap: ORIGINAL ROW NOT COMPLETE: no qualified reviewer chose or reviewed tasks; fixtures and a credential field cannot supply one.
rows.external_evidence_or_claim_limit: A qualified actual reviewer and suitable task review cannot be invented by a fixture or a credential field.

rows.original_description: Freeze the question, source scope, task identity, and comparison digest before a session opens.
rows.code: PRC_TASK_FROZEN: question, claim version digest, source scope with source hashes, salted comparison commitment

rows.original_description: Build an evidence-reading and reasoning view that allows an unaided attempt before the normal comparison view becomes available.
rows.code: session page + evidence view (PRC_EVIDENCE_READ = access, not comprehension); comparison closed until the attempt
current_candidate_checks: v8/workbench/modules/journey_modules.py (installed wheel + sdist) step 4 (14 pages + direct request)

rows.original_description: Require a judgment, supporting reasoning, relevant source references, and an explicit unresolved option; record assistance and prior exposure as declarations.
rows.code: commit_attempt requires judgment or UNRESOLVED, reasoning, in-scope source refs; declarations ASSISTED / ALREADY_EXPOSED accepted and labelled

rows.original_description: Preserve the attempt without replacement; record later revisions as separate reflection rather than rewriting the original response.
rows.code: content-addressed attempt written before the committing event; never replaced; reflection and feedback are later events

rows.original_description: Separate question and comparison storage permissions where genuine confidentiality is required; do not describe the local CLI ordering check as access control.
rows.code: server-held salted vault object; practice-only principals confined to practice routes once principals exist; one E_NOT_FOUND for missing and foreign sessions
rows.remaining_gap: Outside the boundary by design and stated in the guide: host administrator, curator, administrator principal, outside help, public answers.

rows.original_description: Reveal a clearly labeled comparison and support discussion; distinguish an unadjudicated model answer from an independently reviewed reference.
rows.code: reveal shows provenance UNADJUDICATED_REFERENCE / MODEL_ANSWER / REVIEWED_REFERENCE (a declaration) with 'not ground truth' wording; feedback thread
rows.remaining_gap: An independently reviewed reference needs an actual review: none exists; the label stays a declaration.
rows.external_evidence_or_claim_limit: An independently reviewed reference needs an actual review; an unadjudicated comparison must retain that label.

rows.original_description: Add optional reflection, reviewer feedback, and exportable records; protect participant privacy and avoid unsupported employee capability rankings.
rows.code: reflect, feedback, modexport with preview/withheld text; private by default; no ranking or training export exists

rows.original_description: Design delayed, unaided assessment with consent, suitable tasks, and a comparator workflow; measure accuracy and reasoning transfer, not only assisted task scores.
rows.code: schedule_followup + due_state (NOT_YET_DUE / DUE / COMPLETED) as local due-states; nobody is contacted
rows.remaining_gap: ORIGINAL ROW NOT COMPLETE: no consented delayed assessment, comparator workflow or learning-transfer measurement was run; none is authorized here.
rows.external_evidence_or_claim_limit: Software and study design do not demonstrate learning transfer; no human study or recruitment is authorized here.

rows.original_description: Retain journal replay and independently held checkpoints; document that records alone cannot prove human authorship, no outside assistance, or research originality.
rows.code: journal replay; PRC_CHECKPOINT_ISSUED signed envelope held separately; verify_packet detects truncation/alteration against it; guide states what records cannot prove

rows.original_description: Document trusted approval roots, untrusted inputs, source owners, executable identity, and the exact outputs that cross the boundary.
rows.code: shield.py / sandbox_bootstrap.py docstrings + operator guide §7: trust roots, untrusted inputs, fixed executable, exact typed outputs

rows.original_description: Provision approved pins through a separately controlled process; the submitting agent must not be able to approve its own evidence bundle.
rows.code: approvals are admin-only signed events; approver != submitter incl. dual-role and pre-approved self-submission; no trust on first use from an import

rows.original_description: Add approval identity, expiry, rotation, revocation, and retrieval records without weakening exact-byte matching.
rows.code: approval binds approver, key, expiry, policy version; rotation (new root + revocation), revocation, decision events as retrieval/audit records; exact-byte sha256 lookup unchanged

rows.original_description: Preserve strict JSON validation, duplicate-key rejection, numerical constraints, depth limits, and documented input and file budgets.
rows.code: shield_worker.strict_json / read_archive bounds; core.strict_json; upload refused on Content-Length before reading

rows.original_description: Preserve safe relative-file access and rejection of escaping paths, symbolic links, inappropriate file types, and unstable reads.
rows.code: member-name allow-list, no links/special files, duplicate names, ratio; staged input O_NOFOLLOW, regular single-link, stable read
rows.remaining_gap: A true concurrent-replacement race was not staged; the before/after fstat identity check that would catch it is unit-tested only through link/special/size cases.

rows.original_description: Keep evidence bodies inert during verification; expose only typed fields, fixed result codes, and permitted references to privileged callers.
rows.code: typed result without excerpts; fixed CODES; separate escaped inspection view for admin/review

rows.original_description: Place the verifier in an operating-system and service boundary with resource limits, least privilege, and controlled network and secret access.
rows.code: sandbox_bootstrap: Landlock + seccomp + rlimits + no_new_privs (or bubblewrap), empty environment, closed descriptors, bounded output/time; live probe gates use
rows.remaining_gap: Executor: landlock backend VERIFIED by probe; bubblewrap UNAVAILABLE (host AppArmor restriction — a platform gap, not worked around). x86-64 seccomp table and hosted-runner kernel: unverified until a hosted run. Process confinement, not a container.

rows.original_description: Wire production routes to fail closed on rejection; prohibit fallback to an unshielded evaluator under the same protected API promise.
rows.code: admit() is the only path to a typed result; consumers call require_current inside their commit; no in-process parser exists in the parent

rows.original_description: Protect approval and audit stores from tenant crossover and untrusted writes; record administrative changes and emergency revocations.
rows.code: per-workspace registry and approvals bound to workspace id; admin-only writes; every administrative change and revocation is a journal event
rows.remaining_gap: Single-workspace product: 'tenant crossover' is tested as workspace crossover; there is no multi-tenant host.

rows.original_description: Test parser exhaustion, tampering, stale approvals, unsafe files, malicious instruction text, and compromised approval inputs at the integrated boundary.
rows.code: integrated boundary tests incl. sensitivity variant

rows.original_description: Keep source authentication and factual adjudication as separate checks; a correctly approved false document must remain a documented possible failure.
rows.code: decision fields byte_integrity / authority_approval / factual_adjudication NOT_ASSESSED / release_permission NONE; approved false statement in the negative control

rows.original_description: Obtain independent security review for the actual deployed architecture before making product security claims; publish the supported threat model and limits.
rows.code: threat model and limits published in the guide, Modules page, CHANGELOG and notes
rows.remaining_gap: ORIGINAL ROW NOT COMPLETE: NO independent security review of the deployed architecture has been performed; no product security claim is made.
rows.external_evidence_or_claim_limit: Independent security review of the actual deployment is NOT_PERFORMED; original row cannot be marked COMPLETE from internal tests.

rows.original_description: Connect the eight-part inventory: model, agent code, tool policy, memory, data, runtime, grader, and evaluation data.
rows.code: evolution.COMPONENTS, collect(): eight parts with MEASURED / DECLARED / UNKNOWN / NOT_APPLICABLE

rows.original_description: Measure actual runtime and deployment identities where available; mark mutable provider aliases and unavailable identities as unresolved rather than inventing hashes.
rows.code: measure_path/measure_runtime from configured roots; provider alias DECLARED; unknown has no digest
rows.remaining_gap: Local files and this interpreter's runtime only; a remote deployment identity is never measured here.

rows.original_description: Record version ancestry, dependency changes, and authority changes; validate supplied graph completeness against the institution's inventory.
rows.code: parent links, changed components, authority digest; closure from the administrator's configuration, not submitted metadata
rows.remaining_gap: ORIGINAL ROW PARTIAL: completeness against an institution's authoritative inventory is unknown — no such inventory exists to validate against.
rows.external_evidence_or_claim_limit: Institution-wide completeness is unknown without an actual authoritative institutional inventory.

rows.original_description: Reuse evaluation evidence only when its dependency scope, fingerprint, protocol, and validity period still apply; explain each reuse decision.
rows.code: reuse_decisions with reasons: closure, protocol digest, authority digest, ancestry, validity

rows.original_description: Authenticate model improvers, reviewers, graders, test custodians, and release authorizers; check relevant conflicts through ancestry.
rows.code: authenticated improver, grader, reviewer, resolver; conflicts checked through ancestry
rows.remaining_gap: Release authorizers are recorded in the authority state only; no release is authorized by this software.

rows.original_description: Track protected-test access; revoking access does not erase previous exposure, and a new digest alone does not prove semantic test freshness.
rows.code: EVO_TEST_ACCESS_RECORDED; exposure persists after REVOKED; gap text on new digests

rows.original_description: Keep matching failures open until an authorized resolution process addresses them; a later pass, expiry, or renamed protocol cannot silently erase failure.
rows.code: stable issue ids; open until EVO_FAILURE_RESOLVED with a trusted-runner PASS on the lineage covering the scope; unrelated lineages not held

rows.original_description: Show current unreviewed transitions, evidence age, and unresolved review gaps; distinguish retrospective review from evidence available at a historical release.
rows.code: audit(): unreviewed transitions, evidence age, gaps; as_of by recorded time; backdated assertions labelled

rows.original_description: Link supplied financial commitments to configuration versions and review gaps; group by currency and show unknown amounts separately.
rows.code: EVO_COMMITMENT_LINKED to canonical claims; grouped by currency, unknown amounts separate, no conversion

rows.original_description: Add a separately trusted deployment controller only for institutions that authorize enforcement; the audited agent cannot alter the gate, its rules, or approvals.
rows.code: read-only eligibility answer naming the exact subject
rows.remaining_gap: ORIGINAL ROW NOT COMPLETE BY DESIGN: no separately trusted deployment controller exists; it needs an institution's separately authorized integration.
rows.external_evidence_or_claim_limit: External institutional deployment enforcement requires separately authorized integration and is not implemented by an audit result.

rows.original_description: Provide change-diff views, targeted reevaluation requests, independent review exports, and explicit unknown-inventory findings.
rows.code: version page: change from parent, typed reevaluation requests, module packet export, UNKNOWN_INVENTORY findings

rows.original_description: Evaluate missed material changes, unnecessary reevaluation, review delay, and identity failures using real controlled version changes and a strong baseline.
rows.code: tools/yuclaw_v8_module_measure.py: targeted vs repeat-everything on real file changes with ground truth
current_candidate_checks: v8/V8-014/measurements.json (0 missed, 0 unnecessary; 6 vs 18 and 12 vs 36)
rows.remaining_gap: Controlled single-component changes on one machine; review delay and identity failures in a real organization were not measured; the baseline's time is an estimate.

not_advice: Research and education only. Not investment advice.
